phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase A2 — F2M External Complement Identity Audit
purpose: Test whether the five resident-holder to rest-of-world F2M cells can be derived as unique accounting complements rather than allocated residuals.
hypothesis: For each resident holder, W0 F2M assets equal the complete resident-issuer deposit submatrix plus the single remaining rest-of-world issuer X. The X value is eligible as an exact complement only if independent aggregate controls close.

official_counterpart_area_semantics.W0: World / all counterpart areas including the reference area

required_gates: H and C issuer columns are structurally NOT_APPLICABLE under ESA 2010
all resident deposit-issuer columns F/G/BNR are observed or exact-derived
holder W0 F2M totals are available on definitionally identical dimensions
published total-economy W0 and W1 F2M controls are available

independently constructed domestic bilateral submatrix equals the implied domestic aggregate W0 minus W1 within tolerance; a directly published W2 aggregate, when available, is an additional control but is not required when unpublished
sum of the five independently calculated holder-level X complements equals the published total-economy W1 F2M asset control within tolerance
frequency, instrument, accounting entry, consolidation, unit, currency denominator, valuation, prices and transformation are identical
control_independence_rule: The domestic-submatrix control is calculated without using any holder→X candidate. The W1 control is published independently by ECB QSA. Thus the check does not validate a residual with itself.
promotion_rule: Only if the independent domestic partition control and the published W1 aggregate control both pass for stock and flow may holder→X be classified as exact DERIVED QSA complements in a later materialization PR.
failure_rule: If either independent control fails or W0/W1 is unavailable, the external F2M column remains unresolved and BOP/IIP/BNR external statistics are investigated only as separately reconciled sources.
prohibited: allocating a total external aggregate across holders by shares
using a row residual when more than one issuer cell is unresolved
treating an unavailable direct W2 aggregate as zero
using BOP/IIP F2 currency-and-deposits as if it were QSA F2M deposits without an explicit instrument bridge
